what: a block of white matter with other structures in it, some in two pieces: the smaller piece of a class goes, pieces are joined by faces only, of two as large the first met is kept, a chance of exactly 0.25 joins nothing, and of two chances that are equal the first wins

chances.holds: little-endian f32; the chance of each structure at each voxel of the padded grid, as a network's [x, y, z, structure] with the structure fastest: values[((x * padded_y + y) * padded_z + z) * structures + structure]

labels.holds: little-endian i32; SynthSeg's label at each voxel of the grid as stored: columns fastest, then rows, then slices: values[(slice * rows + row) * cols + col]
